purpose: Independent evaluation protocol for visibility-only V0/VZ/V1; no multiresolution change

scope.observation_unit: one linked cell; 20 chromosome rows are not biological replicates

training_protocol.real_start: independent original 014 start for each endpoint
training_protocol.same_bin: saturated nuisance layer; excluded from eta profiling

V0.description: Original C0 raw-y/q count objective with fixed exposure
V0.exposure: e=sqrt(endpoint_count+10), normalized to full-grid mean one

VZ.description: V0 boundary control with zero exposure only at observed offdiag degree-zero bins
VZ.exposure: V0 e on degree-positive bins; e=0 on observed offdiag degree-zero bins
VZ.interpretation: boundary-effect control, not known true invisibility
VZ.synthetic_precheck: P2/N2 have zero offdiag zero-degree bins, so synthetic VZ is V0-equivalent and no extra fit is allowed

V1.description: Per-genomic-bin visibility profile shared by the two copies
V1.parameterization: raw-y/q plus eta; e=exp(eta), one shared e per genomic bin
V1.likelihood: profile group-total Poisson/multinomial likelihood conditional on geometry
V1.eta_denominator: offdiag pair groups only; same-bin nuisance excluded
V1.eta_gauge: active-bin mean-zero gauge; one active scale degree removed
V1.zero_degree_policy: zero-degree bins are outside eta active set and have e=0; sidecar must bind this explicitly
V1.parameter_count_warning: full e vector length is not the number of independent eta parameters

real.scope: within each model V0/VZ/V1 compare only the two source endpoints

synthetic.p_policy: jointly optimize p under the original prior in every arm
synthetic.known_e: synthetic only; not a real endpoint

r2_protocol.metric_scope: R2 only; Spearman-derived structural agreement, not regression R-squared
r2_protocol.grid: existing frozen grid and numeric chromosome/bp joins

two_copy_policy.candidate_action: for each chromosome compare candidate A/B direct and one global A/B swap; choose the geometry-best orientation

derived_metrics.matched: mean of same-copy rho after the best whole-chromosome candidate A/B orientation
derived_metrics.cross: mean of cross-copy rho under that same orientation
derived_metrics.minmargin: minimum of the two same-copy-minus-cross margins

historical_reference.primary_causal_comparison: same-backend V0/VZ/V1 within this visibility round
historical_reference.interpretation: long nonconvex paths may make new V0 differ from old 038 fused M0/B2; beating new V0 does not by itself beat old 038 C0

failed_attempts.known_040_visibility_formal: failed after only V0-consensus first 5 Mb at 612 FG; not an endpoint and not included in 10470 maximum accounting

population_predictive_kl.scope: synthetic-only observational model check; calculated only after all endpoint and source hashes pass
population_predictive_kl.purpose: synthetic-only population predictive check; separate from training NLL on the current sampled counts
population_predictive_kl.true_distribution: for each g in {cis_offdiag, inter}, r_true is exact v1 generation_rates(truth_geometry, generating_e, p_gen=0.8, kernel=v1); pi_true_i=r_true_i/sum_{j in E_g} r_true_j
population_predictive_kl.fit_distribution: for each candidate, r_fit is the same exact kernel evaluated at locked candidate X, locked p, and its model final e sidecar; pi_fit is normalized within the same E_g
population_predictive_kl.zero_observed_pairs: all eligible pairs remain in E_g, including count-zero observations
population_predictive_kl.same_bin: excluded from both groups; diagonal nuisance does not enter eta or KL
population_predictive_kl.support_rule: if pi_true_i>0 and pi_fit_i=0, report KL=+inf; never clip it away
population_predictive_kl.excess_nll: report weighted KL in nats per observed offdiag record; optional total excess NLL is denominator times weighted KL
population_predictive_kl.feasibility_result: exactly supported by the existing v1 generation_rates kernel and group normalization; no approximation is needed

n2_policy.truth: duplicated common truth matrix across reference columns
n2_policy.contrast: algebraically zero; not evidence that no false difference exists
n2_policy.n_only: report same-x0 initial, each final, signed arm deltas and two-arm differences; diagnostic only
n2_policy.rms_limit: relative copy-scale differences are included and cannot identify a unique prior or optimizer cause

plot_protocol.source_comparison: tables only; no duplicate source figures, PDF, or HTML

sidecar_alignment.degree_residual: computed as degree-predicted_degree only for V1; max(abs(r)/max(1,d)) <= 1e-10
sidecar_alignment.non_profile_degree_policy: V0/VZ/known-e may report degree prediction as NA or omit it; no finite-zero placeholder is required
sidecar_alignment.p_q_consistency: sidecar p/q must equal terminal record p/q and p_from_q(q) within 1e-12; p is strictly bounded

release_gate.required_real_source_selection: two source records per V0/VZ/V1 and explicit tie result
release_gate.required_parent_terminal: all 12 fits terminal, 24 stages, actual outer-FG totals reported and no greater than 10470 maximum, no active jobs
release_gate.reference_and_truth: evaluation-only; not opened by preparation or preflight
